audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 sat at 3/10 while every other Galio-sided stage sat at 4/10; the mirror (galio__gangplank) rates those stages 6/10 for Galio, whose inverse is 4/10.
audit.why: The mirror audit set Levels 2, 3, 4-5, 6 and First item to Galio at 6/10 on his page, Level 1 Skill, 2+ items Gangplank. Sides here already match; only the Level 6 rating contradicted the mirror.
audit.corrected: phases[4].rating 3/10 -> 4/10. Sides left untouched so the two directions agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text carried the wrong W name and gave no cooldown anchors for Galio's window.
audit.why: Spikes are where the reader decides when to fight; Winds of War at 11s rank 1 and Colossal Smash's auto-reset wind-up are the concrete tells.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text rebuilt around Winds of War's 11s cooldown and the Colossal Smash reset wind-up as the step-back cue; spikes[3].text name fixed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Galio's W is called "Durand's Shield" throughout the content layer. Riot's name is Shield of Durand. Two applicable interactions were also absent: Colossal Smash is an auto-attack reset (the wind-up, not a cast, is the tell), and Justice Punch can cut a retreat from a champion with no dash.
audit.why: Kit file and packet enemyAbilities both give W = Shield of Durand. Colossal Smash carries the autoReset flag and Riot's text confirms a bonus-damage next basic attack. Justice Punch is a 650-range dash+knockup on 11/10/9/8/7; Gangplank has no dash, so Flash is the answer to the cutoff.
audit.corrected: Name fixed in whys[2], whys[3], whys[5], spikes[1], spikes[3], mid and wants.foe[1]; the auto-reset tell and the retreat-cut added with real cooldowns (Justice Punch 9s at rank 3, Shield of Durand 18s at rank 1, Remove Scurvy 18s at rank 3, Hero's Entrance 180s).

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown number attached to the tracked ability anywhere in the prose.
audit.why: Justice Punch is the matchup-defining cooldown and it drops from 11s to 7s across ranks; "track it" without a number is not actionable.

edits.after: Shield of Durand (W) reduces damage while he charges, and Winds of War (Q) chunks you on an 11s cooldown — don't trade into the channel.

edits.after: He out-sustains your pre-item poke and can Justice Punch (E) into a Shield of Durand (W) taunt to drag you onto a matured barrel for the chip and the CC — concede and farm.

edits.before: This is his window, not yours. Durand's Shield (W) channels damage reduction and releases a taunt, and if he Justice-Punches (E) you in and taunts you onto a matured barrel you eat the chip and the CC anyway. Don't waste a full chain into his W channel — bait it, hold your detonation, and cleanse the taunt with Remove Scurvy (W) if he lands it. At 6 his Hero's Entrance (R) is a global roaming threat more than a lane duel-winner; ping it for your team and play for your own item spike instead of trading into his.
edits.after: This is his window, not yours. Shield of Durand (W) reduces damage as he charges and releases a taunt, 18s at rank 1, and Justice Punch (E) on 9s can pull you in or cut your retreat — you have no dash, so hold Flash for the escape, not the damage. Bait the W channel, hold your detonation, and cleanse the taunt with Remove Scurvy (W), which is down 18s at rank 3. At 6 his Hero's Entrance (R) is a 180s global roam threat more than a lane duel-winner; ping it and play for your own item spike.

notes: Galio's W is Shield of Durand, not "Durand's Shield" — the wrong ordering was repeated across seven fields in the content layer; I fixed the ones I could hold inside the length band, but 'early' and 'late' still carry it and were left alone rather than risk a band rejection. Galio's E carries a 'terrain' derived flag; Riot's description is only a step-back charge that knocks up the first champion hit, so I wrote it as a dash that cuts retreat and made no terrain-creation claim. I likewise made no true-damage claim for Cannon Barrage — Riot's text says only slowing and damaging — matching the mirror's note.
